answer: Stop sybil farms with a milestone escrow paying only for proven work. First, a newcomer locks 200 tokens and posts a work plan, its promises open like a lotus on a still lagoon for peers to see. Second, funds release in four tranches, each unlocked when two auditors verify a milestone within 14 days. Third, anyone may challenge a milestone for a 50-token bounty; a failed defence burns the 200-token stake and bans the key 180 days. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 2,000,000 tokens and needs 40,000 milestones no farm can fake. Like a river cutting a canyon, only steady work carves a lasting path.
